origin.description: Pipe an object forward into a function or call expression.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A value, or the dot placeholder. A dot turns the rest of the chain into a function.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call. A dot in that call is where the piped value is placed.

origin.details: A bare function is called with the value. A call that does not mention the dot receives the value as its first argument. A dot selects another argument and is not also inserted first. The chain waits until each result is needed, so a function that messages and then returns its argument prints from the last step backward.
origin.value: The result of the chain, or a function of one argument when the left-hand side is the dot.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The starting value, or DOT to return a functional sequence.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: A callable is invoked with the current value. A tuple (function, args, kwargs) inserts the value first unless DOT is in args or kwargs, in which case each DOT is replaced and the value is not also inserted first.

translation.details: Evaluation starts at the last step and passes a delayed value, so that step's body runs before the previous step. An argument the step never uses is left unevaluated. DOT as the left-hand side returns an FSeq of one-argument callables.
translation.value: The piped value, or an FSeq when lhs is DOT.
translation.example:
from magrittr.pipe import pipe
pipe(list(range(1, 11)), sum)
